propositions: Version 0.11.0 must be bumped in pyproject.toml, server.json, and uv.lock with matching lockstep validation passing all guards, lints, type checks, and tests.
Release commit requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id trailer, and rebar-ticket trailer, with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submission to main.
release.yml dispatch from main with version=0.11.0 and required pypi environment approval must complete all jobs successfully and publish wheel/sdist to PyPI with PEP 740 provenance bundle.
PyPI provenance must be verifiable with `pypi-attestations verify pypi` against the authoritative PyPI store, not GitHub Artifact Attestations SLSA API.
GitHub Release v0.11.0 tag, artifacts, and MCP Registry entry must be created; Homebrew tap must auto-bump to matching sdist URL and SHA-256.
Fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.11.0 from PyPI must pass scripts/probe_rebar.py with zero failures; all receipts, exceptions, and rollback disposition recorded on ticket.
